tasks.title: Land the custom-node filtering regression proof

invariants.name: actual host non-node entries are ignored
invariants.description: Given the reported host listing of __pycache__, example_node.py.example, and websocket_image_save.py, collection returns the ComfyUI commit with an empty customNodes array.
invariants.test_case_name: ignores the render host's non-node custom_nodes entries

invariants.name: excluded names override positive signals
invariants.description: Directory or symlink candidates whose names begin with . or __ are excluded even if they otherwise look like a Git repository or copied Python package.
invariants.test_case_name: ignores hidden, dunder-prefixed, and package-less directories

invariants.name: package-less directories are ignored
invariants.description: A visible non-Git directory without a regular __init__.py file is omitted instead of being reported as not_git.
invariants.test_case_name: ignores hidden, dunder-prefixed, and package-less directories

invariants.name: valid Git and copied nodes remain sorted
invariants.description: Git repositories remain tracked with exact commits, copied directories with a regular __init__.py remain not_git, and included entries retain lexical ordering.
invariants.test_case_name: git provenance sorts Git and copy-installed custom nodes

invariants.name: actual host non-node entries are ignored
invariants.description: The collector skips the __pycache__ directory and ignores loose files, yielding no custom nodes for the exact reported host listing.
invariants.test_case_name: ignores the render host's non-node custom_nodes entries

invariants.name: excluded names never enter classification
invariants.description: Candidate names beginning with . or __ are removed before Git or copied-package inspection regardless of their contents.
invariants.test_case_name: ignores hidden, dunder-prefixed, and package-less directories

invariants.name: not-git candidates require a Python package entry point
invariants.description: After readGitCommit identifies a visible candidate as not a Git repository, the collector emits not_git only when __init__.py resolves to a regular file and skips it otherwise.
invariants.test_case_name: ignores hidden, dunder-prefixed, and package-less directories

invariants.name: valid Git and copied nodes remain sorted
invariants.description: A Git repository is tracked without requiring __init__.py, a copied package is not_git, and all included entries remain lexically sorted.
invariants.test_case_name: git provenance sorts Git and copy-installed custom nodes

invariants.name: unresolvable Git repositories remain unavailable
invariants.description: When Git metadata exists but its commit cannot be resolved, the candidate stays in the inventory as unavailable and does not enter the copied-node fallback.
invariants.test_case_name: classifies corrupted or unresolvable custom-node repository as unavailable
